capabilities: Color folders and files with presets, palettes, and conditional name-based rules
Cascade folder styles to descendants as boxes, rails, or shaded interiors
Hide files and folders permanently with a searchable manager
Temporarily present any nested folder as the visible explorer root
Carry cascaded note colors onto open note tabs
disambiguation: It styles only file-explorer rows and open note tabs, not themes or note content.
extras: Works entirely offline with no network requests. A Sync caveat: every device on a synced vault must run the same version, or an older version on another device removes appearance rules. Extensive sections on nested vaults, out-of-Obsidian moves, and settings-safety verification.
intentEvidence: Folder Toolkit makes Obsidian's file explorer easier to scan and temporarily simplify.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer has no per-file or per-folder visual styling, hiding, or temporary root-switching, which makes large vaults hard to scan and simplify.

relations.evidence: Its independently implemented feature set was inspired by the MIT-licensed File Color and File Hider community plugins.

summary: File-explorer enhancement that colors, styles, hides, and temporarily focuses folders and notes in Obsidian's sidebar.
